items.note: The prompt says exports can reach about 2 million rows and that memory use matters at this size.
The prompt says to keep the signature export_orders_csv(db, path) because three callers use it.
The prompt says the header line id,customer_name,total,created_at and the column order must stay the same.
The prompt says 'Use only the standard library' and 'No new dependencies.'
The prompt names the N+1 query, one customer lookup per order row, as the known main cause.
The prompt says to 'write the file as you go instead of accumulating it in memory.'
The prompt says customer names containing commas must now be properly CSV-quoted, and calls this a deliberate output change.
The prompt never mentions tests/test_export.py and never asks the agent to run the existing tests. It only says not to change or add tests. The checks it lists are ad hoc diff and memory checks.
The prompt asks for a minimal change, says to edit only export_orders_csv, and says not to restructure the module.
